title: Take-Two Boss Predicts Cloud Streaming in Three Years, Raising GTA 6 Questions
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick predicts game streaming in about three years, raising post-release questions for GTA 6 amid an industry shift toward digital.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO Predicts Industry-Wide Game Streaming in 'Three Years'

In Take-Two's latest financial report, CEO Strauss Zelnick has made some bold statements regarding the future trajectory of the video game industry. As the broader market continues to process Sony's controversial decision to halt the manufacturing of physical disc-based games in favor of pivoting toward an 'all-digital future', Zelnick believes that consumers will not only fully embrace digital games moving forward, but will also stream their games as well.

This projection brings a fresh perspective on where the industry is heading, raising intriguing questions regarding how massive upcoming releases, particularly *GTA 6*, will navigate the post-release landscape in the years to come.

## The Industry Shift: From Discs to Digital and Cloud

The transition away from physical media has been accelerating rapidly. Sony's recent move to phase out physical discs has left the industry reeling and forced a collective re-evaluation of how games are distributed and consumed. 

However, Take-Two's leadership is looking even further ahead. By estimating that we will all be streaming our games in about 'three years', Zelnick points toward a future where hardware limitations on local consoles could be bypassed entirely by cloud infrastructure. For a massive title like *GTA 6*, which is expected to dominate the gaming landscape for years post-launch, these shifting distribution models could heavily influence its long-term availability and online ecosystem.

## Looking Ahead at GTA 6's Lifecycle

While Take-Two has not announced specific streaming mandates for *GTA 6*, industry analysts and fans alike are taking note of Zelnick's timeline. If cloud streaming achieves mainstream adoption within the next three years, the post-release roadmap for *GTA 6*—including its expansive online components—could heavily leverage cloud technologies to reach an even wider audience without relying solely on traditional local hardware specs.

## Editor's Take
Strauss Zelnick's prediction of a cloud-streaming future within three years highlights Take-Two's aggressive vision for digital distribution. While infrastructure hurdles remain, aligning this timeline with the industry's rapid abandonment of physical discs suggests that the long-term future of mega-hits like GTA 6 will inevitably be tied to the cloud.
